# Code of conduct

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful, assume good intent, welcome newcomers, and keep discussions focused on the work. Harassment of any kind is not tolerated.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to the maintainer through GitHub (<https://github.com/AlexGalhardo>). Reports are handled confidentially, and the enforcement guidelines of the Contributor Covenant apply.
